items.name: Alien Wave
items.note: Rows of aliens march side to side and down while a cannon behind its bunkers picks them off.

items.name: Amber Ledger Spreadsheet
items.note: An amber screen spreadsheet where the cell pointer moves to a figure, a new value is typed on the entry line, the totals recalculate and the sheet flips to a bar graph.

items.name: Amsterdam Canal Bicycles
items.note: A row of tall gabled canal houses glows at golden hour while cyclists ride along the quay and a glass-roofed boat glides down the canal.

items.name: Analog Wall Clock
items.note: A brass wall clock on a dark wall, hour, minute and second hands sweeping in proportion.

items.name: Lotus Pond Temple Dawn
items.note: Five lotus bud temple towers stand dark against the sunrise over a still pond of lotus leaves, as robed monks walk the bank and birds cross the sky.

items.name: API Request Inspector
items.note: A request inspector where API calls stream in with method, path, status and timing bars, and one is opened to show its headers.

items.name: Apollonian Gasket
items.note: An Apollonian gasket of shaded pearls, every gap filled by smaller tangent circles, while the view glides in toward a tangency point and back out.

items.name: Architecture Map
items.note: A system architecture map from clients through a CDN and load balancer to services and data stores, with requests flowing along every link.

items.name: Arctic Icebergs
items.note: Icebergs drift on a dark polar sea under a faint green aurora, the swell rolling past them.

items.name: Asteroid Belt
items.note: Lumpy, cratered asteroids tumble past at different depths, lit warm from one side by a distant sun.

items.name: Aurora Cabin Snowfall
items.note: Green northern lights fold slowly over a snowy log cabin with lit windows, chimney smoke and gently falling snow.

items.name: Aurora Curtains
items.note: Three folded ribbons of aurora, green, teal and rose, sway slowly across the whole sky while their rays drift along each curtain.

items.name: Autumn Forest
items.note: A path winds into orange and red autumn woods while leaves drift down through the light.

items.name: Autumn Harvest
items.note: Pumpkins and a hay bale sit before a wheat field swaying in the sunset while autumn leaves tumble down.

items.name: Autumn Pagoda Maples
items.note: A five tier pagoda stands among red maples on an autumn evening, with lanterns on an arched bridge and maple leaves drifting down.

items.name: Autumn Road Cyclist
items.note: A lone cyclist pedals along a forest road under orange and red autumn trees while leaves drift down through the low sunlight.

items.name: Balloon Valley Sunrise
items.note: Hot air balloons drift and rise over layered valleys at sunrise while mist rolls through the low ground.

items.name: Bar Chart Race
items.note: Ten city bars racing year by year, swapping places as their populations grow.

items.name: Home Computer BASIC
items.note: An 8-bit home computer screen inside its thick border, where a short BASIC loop is typed at the READY prompt and run as a scrolling sine wave of stars.

items.name: Bats Leaving the Cave
items.note: At dusk a colony of bats pours from a cave in the cliff and streams into the orange sky in a long swirling ribbon.

items.name: Busy Bees
items.note: Bumblebees buzz from flower to flower over a sunny meadow, hovering at each bloom before zipping to the next.

items.name: Benchmark Results
items.note: A benchmark runner that measures each case with a live iteration counter and fills a table of timings compared to the last baseline.

items.name: Binary Search Steps
items.note: Binary search on a sorted array of twenty numbers, with lo, mid and hi pointers sliding into place, the discarded half greying out at every step and a log of each comparison until the target is found or proven missing.

items.name: Binary Star Orbit
items.note: A heavy orange star and a lighter blue companion swing around their shared centre of mass on Kepler ellipses, speeding up at closest approach and leaving fading trails.

items.name: Binary Search Tree
items.note: Values inserting into a binary search tree one by one, each comparison lighting the path down before the new node drops into place.

items.name: Firmware Setup Utility
items.note: A retro firmware setup screen where a cursor walks the tabs, enables a setting, reorders boot devices and saves.

items.name: Birthday Cake
items.note: A two-tier birthday cake with dripping frosting and sprinkles; its candles flicker, blow out in a puff of smoke and relight.

items.name: Bisect Hunt
items.note: A bisect session that tests the middle commit, marks it good or bad and halves the range until the first bad commit is found.

items.name: Black Hole
items.note: A black hole's accretion disk swirls around the dark shadow, its far side bent by gravity into a glowing halo.

items.name: Blinking Cursor
items.note: A minimal prompt in big block type where a short word is typed and erased beside a blinking block cursor.

items.name: Block Drop
items.note: A falling-block puzzle that plays itself, sliding each piece into place and clearing full lines.

items.name: Blue Green Switch
items.note: A blue and green deployment where the idle environment boots the new release, passes its smoke tests, and the router flips every request across in one step while the old side drains and stands by.

items.name: Bohr Atom Photon
items.note: A hydrogen electron absorbs an ultraviolet photon and leaps from shell 1 to shell 3, then drops back in two steps, giving out a red 656 nm photon and an ultraviolet one, tracked on an energy level diagram.

items.name: Boids Over Meadow
items.note: A top-down boids flock steers by separation, alignment and cohesion, splitting and regrouping whenever a hunting hawk dives through.

items.name: Boiling Pasta Pot
items.note: A big steel pot at a rolling boil, spaghetti swirling as a wooden spoon stirs, bubbles bursting across the surface and steam pouring up.

items.name: Bonds Break And Form
items.note: Two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule absorb energy to break their bonds, the atoms regroup into two water molecules and more energy is released, traced on an energy profile.

items.name: Bonsai Tree
items.note: A twisted bonsai in a glazed blue pot, its cloud-shaped foliage pads rustling in a soft breeze.

items.name: Boombox Speaker Pump
items.note: A chrome boombox sits against a brick wall, its two speaker cones pumping on every kick while sound rings spread out and the tape reels turn.

items.name: Boot Sequence
items.note: A system boot log scrolls past with green OK tags, then the machine waits at a login prompt.

items.name: Bosphorus Mosque Skyline
items.note: Istanbul's domes and slender minarets stand against a sunset over the Bosphorus, with ferries crossing the strait and gulls wheeling overhead.

items.name: Bouncing Balls
items.note: Six coloured balls fall under gravity, bounce off the floor and walls, lose energy with every hit and settle before the next drop.

items.name: Bouncing Letters
items.note: Block letters drop in one at a time, bounce with a little squash and settle on the floor before falling away.

items.name: Bouncy Green Slime
items.note: A glossy green slime blob hops along a dungeon floor, squashing flat on every landing and stretching tall as it leaps.

items.name: Latency Box Plots
items.note: Horizontal box plots of response time for six services, the boxes, medians, whiskers and outliers shifting as each new window of samples arrives.

items.name: Breaking News Ticker
items.note: A live news graphic where a red breaking banner slides in, each headline types itself into the lower third and a ticker crawls underneath.

items.name: Brian's Brain
items.note: The Brian's Brain cellular automaton: firing cells turn refractory then rest, so gliders and spreading wavefronts sweep endlessly across the grid.

items.name: Brick Breaker
items.note: A paddle that aims its own shots, chipping away at a rainbow wall of bricks until it is gone.

items.name: Wealth and Health Bubbles
items.note: A bubble chart of income against life expectancy for twelve regions, each bubble sized by population and drifting up and to the right decade by decade.

items.name: Bubble Tea Pearls
items.note: A tall cup of brown sugar milk tea, tapioca pearls sucked one by one up a fat pink straw while ice bobs and condensation runs down the cup.

items.name: Burger Stack Build
items.note: A burger builds itself on a wooden board, patty, melting cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion and a sesame bun dropping onto the stack one by one.

items.name: Burning Title
items.note: The word IGNITE glows like hot coals while turbulent flames curl up from every letter into the dark.

items.name: Butterfly
items.note: An orange and black butterfly flaps its patterned wings along a looping path above a flower garden.

items.name: Cake Icing Turntable
items.note: A layer cake turns on a cake stand as a steel spatula smooths pink icing around its side, then cream rosettes and berries appear along the top.

items.name: Calculator Keypad
items.note: A calculator where keys light up as they are pressed, the display builds an expression and the result rolls in on equals.

items.name: Calendar Month
items.note: A month calendar with coloured event dots, today marked, and a selection hopping between days with an agenda panel.

items.name: Twelve Month Heatmap
items.note: Twelve little month calendars fill in day by day with workout minutes, darker squares for rest days and bright ones for big sessions, until the whole year is logged.

items.name: Camel Caravan Dusk
items.note: A caravan of camels walks a desert dune crest against a low dusk sun, kicking up trails of dust.

items.name: Campfire
items.note: A campfire in a ring of stones, flames licking over crossed logs and sparks drifting up into the night.

items.name: Campfire Under Stars
items.note: A crackling campfire sends sparks up toward the milky way while a tent glows in its light.

items.name: Golden Canal Gondola
items.note: A narrow canal between old painted houses at golden hour, with a gondola gliding across, laundry swaying on the lines and ripples moving on the water.

items.name: Canary Rollout Gates
items.note: A canary release that moves traffic from 1 to 100 percent in steps while error rate and latency are compared against the stable build, promoting one release and automatically rolling back the next when its errors spike.

items.name: Candle Flame
items.note: A single candle in a dark room, its flame flickering and wax dripping slowly down the side.

items.name: Candlestick Chart
items.note: Green and red price candles with wicks scrolling left, the newest candle still forming against a live price line.

items.name: Cassette Tape Loading
items.note: An 8-bit computer loading from cassette, the border flashing pilot tone and data stripes while the loading screen picture paints in band by band.

items.name: Cassette Tape Reels
items.note: A handwritten mixtape plays in a deck, its reels turning as the tape winds across, then rewinding fast to the start.

items.name: Castle Bridge Dawn
items.note: An old stone bridge lined with statues crosses a misty river at dawn, with a gothic gate tower at one end and a hilltop castle against a pink sky.

items.name: Edge Cache Hit Miss
items.note: A CDN edge node where requests from three regions hit the cache and return fast, or miss and travel on to the origin, while every cached path counts down its TTL and expires.

items.name: Roadside Chai Dawn
items.note: At first light a chai vendor pours tea from a height while steam rises from the kettle, customers sip and a scooter putters past.

items.name: Chalkboard Lettering
items.note: A stick of chalk writes a big word on a dusty green board, underlines it, and a felt eraser wipes it away for the next one.

items.name: Chameleon and the Fly
items.note: A green chameleon grips a jungle branch, swivels its turret eye after a buzzing fly and catches it with one lightning flick of its tongue.

items.name: Chat Thread
items.note: A chat conversation where bubbles appear after a typing indicator and replies are typed in the composer.

items.name: Checkout Payment Flow
items.note: A checkout page fills shipping and card details, processes the payment and lands on a confirmed order.

items.name: Cherry Blossom River
items.note: A quiet river flows beneath rows of cherry blossom trees as pink petals drift down and float away.

items.name: Chess Replay
items.note: A short classic attacking game replayed move by move on a wooden board, ending in a queen sacrifice and mate.

items.name: Chiptune Tracker
items.note: A four channel music tracker plays a chiptune, note rows scrolling up past the play line while the meters jump, the channel scopes wiggle and the pattern counter steps.

items.name: Chladni Figures
items.note: Sand on a vibrating metal plate jumps off the moving regions and settles on the still nodal lines, redrawing a new figure each time the frequency changes.

items.name: Chocolate Fountain
items.note: Sheets of melted chocolate cascade down a three tier steel fountain into a swirling basin while a strawberry on a skewer is dipped in and pulled out coated.

items.name: Christmas Tree
items.note: A decorated fir tree with twinkling coloured lights, gold garlands and a shining star, presents waiting in the snow.

items.name: CI Pipeline
items.note: A CI pipeline where each run moves through checkout, install, lint, test, build and deploy, with spinners, timings, a live log and the odd failing test.

items.name: Silent Film Title Card
items.note: An old projector reel counts down 3 2 1 with a sweeping leader, then lands on a framed THE END card full of grain, scratches and gate weave.

items.name: Circuit Breaker States
items.note: A circuit breaker that counts failures from a struggling downstream service, trips open to fail fast, waits out a cooldown, sends a trial call while half open and closes again once the service recovers.

items.name: Circuit Lap Racer
items.note: Four cars race lap after lap around a top-down circuit, braking into the corners and trading places while the standings update.

items.name: Circuit Trace
items.note: A strip of circuit board traces with copper pads and vias, green and blue signals racing along them.

items.name: Cliff Lighthouse Night
items.note: A lighthouse on a sea cliff turns its beam across a starry night while a ship passes on the horizon and clouds drift by.

items.name: Whitewashed Cliff Village
items.note: A whitewashed village with blue domes spills down a volcanic cliff above a deep blue sea, with a windmill turning, boats crossing and gulls overhead.

items.name: Clifford Attractor
items.note: A Clifford strange attractor drawn as a glowing density map, its four parameters drifting so the silky folds keep reshaping themselves.

items.name: Clockwork Gears
items.note: A train of brass, copper and steel gears meshing tooth to gap and turning at their true ratios.

items.name: Waving Flag
items.note: A flag ripples on its pole in a gusty wind, travelling waves rolling along the cloth with light and shade in every fold.

items.name: Cloud Drift
items.note: Puffy white clouds drift in slow layers across a deep blue summer sky above distant hills.

items.name: Rolling Deployment
items.note: A cluster rolling update where new pods start, pass readiness and replace old ones while a status line counts up to a successful rollout.

items.name: Cocktail Shaker Pour
items.note: A frosted steel shaker rattles hard, tips over and pours a coral cocktail into a coupe glass, then a lime wheel lands on the rim.

items.name: Code Editor
items.note: An editor window with line numbers where a small rate limiter is typed out in syntax colours.

items.name: Coffee Mug
items.note: A red mug of coffee on a wooden table, wisps of steam curling up into the warm room.

items.name: Coin Run Platformer
items.note: A side-scrolling hero runs on its own through grassy hills, jumping pits, landing on brick ledges, stomping critters and collecting coins.

items.name: Space Colonisation Tree
items.note: A tree grows by the space colonisation algorithm, each branch reaching toward a cloud of attractor points that vanish as they are claimed, then bursts into leaf.

items.name: Color Picker Sliders
items.note: A colour picker where the hue strip, the shade field and the RGB sliders move together and the swatch and hex code follow.

items.name: Colosseum Golden Hour
items.note: The great arched amphitheatre glows gold in the low evening sun as scooters buzz past on the road and a flock of birds wheels overhead.

items.name: Comet Crossing
items.note: A bright comet glides across a starry sky above dark hills, its curved dust tail and straight blue ion tail streaming behind.

items.name: Command Palette
items.note: A command palette drops over a dimmed editor, filters commands as a query is typed and runs the pick.

items.name: Compiler Warnings
items.note: A compiler build log that compiles dependencies, prints an unused variable warning with a pointed snippet and finishes green.

items.name: School Computer Lab
items.note: A school computer lab with three beige terminals on a long desk, one listing a BASIC program in green, one compiling in amber and one playing a bat and ball game, under a ticking wall clock.

items.name: Concert Stage Crowd
items.note: A band plays on a hazy stage as moving head beams sweep and change colour, the screen behind pulses and the crowd jumps with hands in the air.

items.name: Conductor Baton Beats
items.note: A conductor seen from behind leads an orchestra, the baton tip tracing four and three beat patterns with a golden trail and each beat number lighting up.

items.name: Consistent Hash Ring
items.note: A consistent hashing ring where each key belongs to the next node clockwise, and when a node joins or fails only the keys in its arc move, shown as they change owner.

items.name: Constellation Lettering
items.note: On a drifting star chart, bright stars light up and are joined line by line until the constellation spells a word, then it fades into the next.

items.name: Sun in Sunglasses
items.note: A grinning sun in dark sunglasses bobs over the beach as its rays turn, now and then sliding the shades down its nose to give you a wink.

items.name: Copper Bar Demo
items.note: A demoscene intro with glowing copper bars swinging past each other, a rainbow logo wobbling line by line, parallax stars and a big sine wave scroller.

items.name: Magnetic Core Plane
items.note: A magnetic core memory plane where an X and a Y select wire light up together and the ferrite core where they cross flips, bit by bit storing a heart and a smile before the rows are cleared.

items.name: Cotton Candy Spinner
items.note: Pink sugar threads whirl around a carnival spinner tub while a paper cone turns and gathers a growing cloud of cotton candy.

items.name: Countdown Timer
items.note: Big digits count down from ten inside a ring that drains every second, then GO bursts out in green.

items.name: Coverage Report
items.note: A code coverage report where per-file bars fill up, colour by threshold and then re-sort so the weakest files rise to the top.

items.name: CPU Monitor
items.note: A terminal system monitor with eight per-core usage bars, memory and swap, load averages and a busy process list.

items.name: Crate Pusher Puzzle
items.note: A tiny warehouse worker solves box-pushing puzzles on its own, shoving every crate onto a marked spot before moving to the next level.

items.name: CRT Test Card
items.note: An old CRT television showing a colour test card, the picture rolling slowly with visible scanlines.

items.name: Crystal Grain Growth
items.note: Crystals nucleate one by one in a cooling melt and grow outward until they lock together into a mosaic of grains, each with its own lattice angle.

items.name: Cuckoo Clock
items.note: A carved wooden cuckoo clock ticks on a warm wall, pendulum swinging and pinecone weights on their chains, and the little bird pops out to call on the hour.

items.name: Neon Alley
items.note: A rainy night alley runs toward a glowing street, its neon signs buzzing and pooling in the wet ground.

items.name: Cylinder
items.note: A striped cylinder tumbling slowly in space, its curved side and flat caps lit and depth-sorted.

items.name: Dancing Pot Cactus
items.note: A potted cactus with a pink flower on its head sways its hips and swings its arms to a beat against a desert sunset.

items.name: ETL Data Flow
items.note: An ETL pipeline where raw records leave three sources, pass through clean, dedupe and join steps, and land in a warehouse as counters climb.

items.name: Data Table
items.note: A service status table that re-sorts by a new column every few seconds while a selection bar walks the rows.

items.name: Date Range Picker
items.note: A two month calendar where a start date is clicked, the range stretches with the cursor and the night count updates.

items.name: Primary Replica Sync
items.note: Database replication where every write is appended to the primary's log and streamed to three replicas, one cross-region with visible lag and one that loses its link and then catches up in a burst.

items.name: Rubber Duck Debugger
items.note: A yellow rubber duck bobs on rippling water, listening patiently to your bug and thinking out loud in a speech bubble until it is fixed.

items.name: Bug With a Magnifier
items.note: A little red beetle paces along a page of code holding up a magnifying glass, stopping to peer at the line with the error underlined in red.

items.name: Decode Reveal
items.note: A field of cipher noise gives way column by column as a block letter phrase decrypts out of it.

items.name: Delivery Route Tracker
items.note: A delivery tracking screen where the route draws across a street grid, the courier moves along it and the order steps tick to delivered.

items.name: Departures Hall Board
items.note: A full airport departures board with times, flights, destinations, gates and statuses that flip as boarding opens, gates close and flights leave the list.

items.name: Desert Dunes
items.note: Rolling sand dunes bake under a blazing sky while the wind lifts sand off every crest.

items.name: Thar Fort Caravan
items.note: A camel train plods across the dunes below a golden sandstone hill fort with round bastions and domed pavilions as the desert sun sets.

items.name: Desert Needle Skyline
items.note: A needle thin supertall tower rises over a glittering desert city at night, with lit windows changing, cars streaming along the highway and a full moon above the dunes.

items.name: Desk Fan
items.note: An electric desk fan with spinning blades behind a wire guard, its head slowly sweeping left and right.

items.name: Baraat Dhol Night
items.note: A wedding procession at night: a dhol player drums and dances while the groom rides a white horse past lamp bearers, dancers and falling petals.

items.name: Dial-Up Handshake
items.note: A retro terminal program that dials out, shows the modem handshake as a noisy signal with front panel lights, connects and lands on a bulletin board.

items.name: Digital Clock
items.note: A big seven segment clock ticking through the seconds, with ghosted unlit segments and a blinking colon.

items.name: Dijkstra Shortest Path
items.note: Dijkstra's algorithm on a weighted graph, popping the closest node from the priority queue, relaxing each edge and updating distances, then lighting the shortest route from A to O.

items.name: Desert Runner
items.note: A runner sprints across the desert at ever faster speed, jumping cacti until a mistimed leap ends the run.

items.name: Partition Editor
items.note: A curses-style partition editor that carves a new partition out of free space, writes the table and formats it.

items.name: Diwali Diyas
items.note: A row of clay oil lamps flickering on a ledge above a slowly turning rangoli, under a marigold garland.

items.name: DJ Decks Crossfader
items.note: Two turntables spin either side of a mixer while the crossfader slides from one deck to the other and both waveforms scroll past the playhead.

items.name: Diffusion Aggregation
items.note: Random walkers drift in from the dark and stick on contact, building a branching frost-like cluster one particle at a time.

items.name: DNA Replication Fork
items.note: Helicase unzips the double helix, the leading strand is copied in one smooth run and the lagging strand in short Okazaki fragments that are primed, filled and sealed, base letters and all.

items.name: DNS Lookup Path
items.note: A DNS lookup where the resolver asks the root, then the TLD, then the authoritative server, caches each referral and answers the repeat query in two milliseconds.

items.name: DNS Resolver Chain
items.note: A DNS lookup diagram where a query packet hops from the client to the resolver, root, TLD and authoritative servers and the answer returns.

items.name: Donut Chart
items.note: A ring chart filling clockwise to its target with the percentage counting up in the middle.

items.name: Doppler Effect Siren
items.note: A siren drives across while its sound waves crowd together in front and spread out behind, so the listener ahead hears a higher pitch and the one behind a lower one.

items.name: Dosa On The Tawa
items.note: Seen from above, a ladle spirals batter thin across a hot iron tawa, the dosa crisps from cream to gold with ghee at the rim, then is rolled up and slid off.

items.name: Dot Matrix Banner
items.note: A dot matrix printer prints a giant sideways banner on continuous tractor-feed paper, the head racing back and forth as the perforated sheet feeds up and away.

items.name: Pulsing Dot Rule
items.note: A quiet rule of dots where soft pulses of light swell and travel from end to end.

items.name: Double Helix
items.note: Two glossy strands twisting around each other like DNA, joined by coloured base pairs and depth-sorted as they turn.

items.name: Double Line Frame
items.note: A double-line box frame with an inner rule, while comets of gold and blue light chase each other round it.

items.name: Double Pendulum
items.note: A double pendulum swings chaotically under gravity, its lower bob tracing a fading trail that never settles into a pattern.

items.name: Doughnut Glazing Line
items.note: Plain ring doughnuts ride a bakery conveyor under a falling curtain of pink glaze and roll out shiny, dripping and covered in sprinkles.

items.name: Download Queue
items.note: A download manager where six files report size, speed and time left, then finish one by one.

items.name: Dragon Curve
items.note: A line folded in half over and over, each fold swinging out a new copy until the Heighway dragon appears.

items.name: Drum Machine Sequencer
items.note: A 16 step drum machine plays its pattern, the playhead sweeping across lit pads as kick, snare, hats and claps fire, with a fill every fourth bar.

items.name: Rotating Earth
items.note: The earth turns on its tilted axis, continents and clouds sliding from daylight across the terminator into city-lit night.

items.name: East River Bridge Sunrise
items.note: A suspension bridge with gothic stone towers spans the river at sunrise in front of a hazy skyline, with traffic crossing, a tugboat pushing upstream and gulls overhead.

items.name: Easter Eggs
items.note: Five painted eggs with dots, zigzags and stripes wobble in turn in spring grass beneath drifting clouds.

items.name: Solar Eclipse
items.note: The moon slides across the sun as the sky darkens, and at totality the pale corona flares out around the black disc.

items.name: Eid Crescent
items.note: A slim new crescent and twinkling stars rise over a skyline of domes and minarets with warmly lit windows.

items.name: Access Denied Padlock
items.note: A brass padlock's shackle drops and snaps shut with a small jolt above a polite request access button.

items.name: All Caught Up Check
items.note: A green ring and checkmark draw themselves stroke by stroke, pop a little burst and rewind.

items.name: Broken Link Cloud
items.note: A cloud drifts above a chain link that has snapped in two, the halves swinging apart as chips fall from the break.

items.name: Copied To Clipboard
items.note: A pointer clicks copy on an invite link, the lines paste onto a clipboard and a small copied pill pops up.

items.name: Saved To Cloud Tick
items.note: An arrow rises into a soft cloud, a tick is cut into the cloud and a last saved timer starts counting.

items.name: Cobweb Empty Folder
items.note: An empty open folder sits under a corner cobweb while a small spider bobs up and down on its thread.

items.name: Construction Crane Panel
items.note: A tower crane trolleys bricks one at a time from a pile onto a growing wall, an under construction state.

items.name: Empty Inbox Plane
items.note: A paper plane loops a figure eight above an empty inbox tray, trailing a dotted line.

items.name: No Search Results
items.note: A magnifying glass sweeps over empty result rows beneath a search box that came up with nothing.

items.name: Unplugged Offline Cable
items.note: An unplugged cable sways beside its wall socket and throws the odd spark while a retry timer counts down.

items.name: Onboarding Flag Planted
items.note: Checkpoints tick off one by one up a hill path, then a flag drops onto the summit, kicks up dust and waves.

items.name: Payment Declined Shake
items.note: A bank card tries to pay, the charge is declined, the card gives a gentle shake and a red cross appears.

items.name: Payment Success Card
items.note: A bank card slides in, a spinner processes the charge, then a green tick pops and the amount counts up.

items.name: Rate Limit Hourglass
items.note: An hourglass drains grain by grain as a try again in 30 seconds countdown ticks down, then the retry button wakes up.

items.name: Reconnecting Signal Bars
items.note: Signal bars climb on each reconnect attempt, drop when it fails, and all turn green when the connection is back.

items.name: Coming Soon Rocket
items.note: A small rocket vents steam on its pad through a ten second countdown, then lifts off on a column of flame.

items.name: Session Expired Clock
items.note: A sleepy wall clock sweeps its hands while little z's drift up from it, above a sign in again button.

items.name: Smoking Server Box
items.note: A small server box with a dizzy face puffs smoke from its vent, a friendly something went wrong state.

items.name: Task Done Confetti
items.note: A three item checklist ticks itself off and a burst of confetti rains down around the card.

items.name: Trash Lid Closing
items.note: A crumpled page arcs into a bin, the lid swings shut with a bump and an undo timer drains away.

items.name: Upload Into Tray
items.note: A big arrow drops into a file tray while the progress bar fills, then the tray bounces and a tick pops up.

items.name: Welcome Door Opening
items.note: A front door swings open and warm light spills out across the floor, a friendly first run welcome.

items.name: End Credits Roll
items.note: Film end credits roll up a letterboxed screen, roles right-aligned against a centre gutter, names beside them and section headings in between.

items.name: Endless Corridor
items.note: A ray-cast flight down an infinite corridor, ceiling lamps, red doors and a glowing trim line rushing past.

items.name: Food Chain Energy Pyramid

items.name: Three Body Orbit
items.note: Three equal stars chase each other around the famous figure-eight solution of the three-body problem, integrated live over glowing gravity contours.

items.name: Orbiting Planets
items.note: Seven lit planets sweep along tilted elliptical orbits around a boiling sun, inner worlds racing the outer ones.

items.name: Org Chart
items.note: An organisation chart drawing itself from the top down, connectors growing out of each box into the teams below.

items.name: Oscilloscope Wave Morph
items.note: A bench oscilloscope traces a green phosphor wave that morphs smoothly between sine, square, saw and triangle while the readouts follow along.

items.name: OTP Code Entry
items.note: A two step verification screen where a six digit code is typed, shakes as wrong, is retyped and goes green.

items.name: Oven Bread Rising
items.note: Through a glowing oven window a scored loaf rises and turns golden while the timer counts down and steam curls up inside.

items.name: Night Owl
items.note: A horned owl perched on a moonlit branch blinks its big yellow eyes and slowly turns its head to look around.

items.name: Packet Capture
items.note: A packet capture tool streaming colour-coded TCP, UDP, DNS and TLS packets with protocol counters and a hex dump of the selected packet.

items.name: Paddle Tennis
items.note: Two computer paddles rally a ball across a court, keeping score and starting a new match at eleven.

items.name: Paddy Buffalo Sunrise
items.note: Flooded rice paddies mirror a soft sunrise as a farmer leads a water buffalo along the dikes and egrets fly low over the fields.

items.name: Lost In Space 404
items.note: A not found page with a big glowing 404 and a lost satellite drifting through twinkling stars.

items.name: Server Error 500
items.note: A 500 error page with a smoking server rack, blinking fault lights and a retry countdown.

items.name: Pancake Stack Syrup
items.note: Golden pancakes drop one by one onto a plate, a pat of butter lands on top and maple syrup pours over and runs down the stack.

items.name: Loop the Loop Plane
items.note: A cheerful folded paper plane with big eyes glides across a sunny sky, flies a full loop the loop and leaves a dashed trail behind it.

items.name: Paris Rooftops
items.note: Zinc rooftops, chimney smoke and lit windows at twilight, with an iron tower on the far skyline.

items.name: Paris Rooftops Dusk
items.note: The iron lattice tower rises over Paris zinc rooftops at dusk, with chimney smoke drifting, pigeons crossing and the sun going down behind the roofs.

items.name: Election Seat Chart
items.note: A half circle of 201 parliament seats filling in as results are declared, coloured by party, with a running tally and the majority line at 101.

items.name: Particle Rain Lettering
items.note: Bright grains rain from the top and pile up into a big block word, hold for a beat, then pour off the bottom for the next word.

items.name: Password Strength Meter
items.note: A password field where each keystroke moves a strength meter from weak to strong and ticks off the rules.

items.name: Peekaboo Box
items.note: A cardboard box wobbles on the floor, its flaps pop open, two eyes peer out of the dark and a fuzzy orange critter pops up to wave before hiding again.

items.name: Fountain Pen Lettering
items.note: A fountain pen draws a big word stroke by stroke in wet blue ink on ruled paper, then the page turns for the next word.

items.name: Pendulum Wall Clock
items.note: A tall wooden regulator clock hangs on a dark blue wall, its brass pendulum swinging behind the glass, second hand ticking and chimes ringing out on the hour.

items.name: Pendulum Wave
items.note: Fifteen pendulums with carefully tuned lengths swing in and out of phase, forming travelling waves, snakes and chaos before realigning.

items.name: Penguin Belly Slide
items.note: A penguin waddles across the ice shelf past its friends, flops onto its belly and toboggans down the slope into the sea with a splash.

items.name: Penrose Growth
items.note: A Penrose tiling of thick and thin rhombuses assembles itself tile by tile, spreading outward from a seed point that moves each round.

items.name: Perspective Text Crawl
items.note: An opening text crawl of block letters slides away from the viewer toward a vanishing point, shrinking and dimming over a field of stars.

items.name: Rose Cliff Treasury
items.note: A columned temple front carved into rose red cliffs, seen from the end of a dark canyon, with a camel and rider plodding across the sand and dust lifting from its feet.

items.name: Round Tube XY Scope
items.note: A vintage round-tube oscilloscope in X-Y mode, its blue-white beam tracing a slowly rotating figure that leaves a yellow afterglow while the operator turns the frequency knobs.

items.name: Photosynthesis Leaf
items.note: Sunlight, carbon dioxide and water flow into a leaf while glucose travels down the stem and oxygen drifts out, above the balanced equation.

items.name: Piano Keys Melody
items.note: Three octaves of piano keys press down to a gentle melody over a rolling left hand, each note lifting off its key in colour.

items.name: Piano Roll Scroll
items.note: A piano roll editor scrolls bass, chord and melody notes past the playhead, lighting each key on the side keyboard as it plays, with a velocity lane below.

items.name: Pie Chart
items.note: A round pie chart of traffic sources turning slowly, each slice lifting out in turn beside its legend.

items.name: Pipe Flyer
items.note: A little bird flaps its way through gaps in an endless row of pipes, starting over when it clips one.

items.name: Pixel Fire
items.note: The classic demoscene fire, heat rising from a white hot base and breaking into flickering tongues.

items.name: Saluting Pixel Knight
items.note: A small armoured knight stands before a castle wall with its shield, then raises its sword in a proud salute while its red plume bobs and banners wave.

items.name: Monochrome Paint Program
items.note: An early black and white paint program where the cursor drags out a house with the rectangle, line and oval tools, floods it with patterns and sprays grass before clearing the page.

items.name: Pizza Cheese Pull
items.note: A cutter wheel rolls through a hot pepperoni pizza, then a slice is lifted high, trailing long strings of melted cheese.

items.name: Pocket Planet Astronaut
items.note: A tiny astronaut stands on top of a slowly turning pocket planet, waving hello from inside a round helmet as stars drift past.

items.name: Sine Plasma
items.note: A classic sine plasma, rainbow bands rolling and folding into each other.

items.name: Pod Autoscaler
items.note: A container cluster view where a traffic spike pushes CPU up, new pods spin up across the nodes, then scale back down as load eases.

items.name: Polar Ring Clock
items.note: A polar clock of three concentric rings, the outer one sweeping round with the seconds, the middle with the minutes and the inner with the hours, the time printed in the centre.

items.name: Popcorn Pot
items.note: A steel pot sits on a blue gas flame, the lid rattling as fluffy popcorn bursts out in arcs and piles up across the stovetop.

items.name: Porch Wind Chimes
items.note: Copper wind chimes hang from a porch roof at sunset, swinging and knocking together in the gusts while leaves blow across the garden behind.

items.name: Power-On Memory Count
items.note: A retro power-on self test that counts up memory, detects drives one by one and hands off to the boot loader.

items.name: Pour Over Drip
items.note: A gooseneck kettle spirals hot water over blooming grounds in a ceramic cone while coffee drips steadily into a glass carafe.

items.name: Pressure Cooker Whistle
items.note: An aluminium pressure cooker on a gas flame builds pressure, its weight rattles, then it whistles out a jet of steam while a note on the wall counts to three.

items.name: Pricing Plan Toggle
items.note: A three plan pricing table where the billing switch flips between monthly and yearly, prices roll to the new numbers and a plan is picked.

items.name: Prism Dispersion
items.note: A beam of white light bends as it enters and leaves a glass prism, and because violet bends more than red it fans out into the colours of the spectrum on a screen.

items.name: Process Viewer Sort
items.note: An interactive process viewer with meter bars where the table slides into a new order as the sort column changes.

items.name: Process Task Manager
items.note: A task manager where per process CPU and memory numbers churn, rows slide to re-sort by load, and a runaway process gets ended.

items.name: Process Tree Live
items.note: A live process tree with branch lines where build workers and request handlers spawn in green, run and exit in red.

items.name: Progress Loader
items.note: Four terminal progress bars filling at their own pace, with percent and a spinner.

items.name: Projectile Arcs
items.note: A cannon fires the same charge at four angles, and each ball traces its true parabola so you can compare their heights and ranges.

items.name: Pub Sub Fan Out
items.note: A publish and subscribe diagram where each order event lands on a topic and fans out to four subscriber queues, one of them slow enough to build a backlog that it later works through.

items.name: Pulse Line
items.note: Two pulses of light with glowing tails race in opposite directions along a thin line and light its end caps.

items.name: Keypunch Card Deck
items.note: A keypunch types a short program onto 80-column cards, the holes appearing column by column before each finished card slides off to the stacker.

items.name: Puzzle Cube Turns
items.note: A three by three colour puzzle cube turning while its layers twist one quarter turn at a time, scrambling and then solving itself.

items.name: Pyramid
items.note: A square pyramid turning slowly above its shadow, each sandstone face lit flat with bright edges.

items.name: Quote Of The Day
items.note: A card rotates through original quotes, each sliding up and out as the next one rises into place, with page dots and a timer bar.

items.name: Radar Skill Profile
items.note: A spider chart compares two engineers across six skills, the blue and orange shapes morphing smoothly as each new pair of profiles loads.

items.name: Radial Sound Bars
items.note: A circular audio visualiser where rainbow spectrum bars radiate from a spinning record, the ring swelling on each kick as sparks fly outward.

items.name: Radio Dial Tuning
items.note: A wooden valve radio tunes across the band, the red needle gliding over a glowing amber dial through crackling static until it locks onto the next station.

items.name: Raincloud Cheers Up
items.note: A gloomy little cloud rains on a green meadow until it cheers up, turns fluffy white and pushes a rainbow out across the sky.

items.name: Written in Rain
items.note: A steady downpour where every drop passing through a hidden word lights up, so the word appears written in falling rain.

items.name: Rain Shower
items.note: A heavy shower slanting over a dark meadow, drops splashing into rippling puddles.

items.name: Rainbow After Rain
items.note: A rain shower drifts past over green hills, the clouds part and a full rainbow arcs across the clearing sky.

items.name: Rainbow Text
items.note: Chunky block letters with a full rainbow gradient sweeping across them and a bright glint passing through.

items.name: Rainbow Warp Road
items.note: A rainbow striped highway snakes away through deep space at warp speed, its colour bands rushing underfoot as stars streak past.

items.name: Rainforest Falls Mist
items.note: A tall waterfall pours down a mossy cliff into a jungle pool, with mist rolling off the water, ferns swaying in front and birds crossing the canopy light.

items.name: Rainy Window
items.note: Raindrops slide down a window pane in front of the blurred, glowing lights of a city at night.

items.name: Ramadan Lanterns
items.note: Brass lanterns with coloured glass glow and sway on long chains beneath a crescent moon, above a softly lit arcade.

items.name: Ramen Noodle Lift
items.note: A deep red bowl of ramen with egg, pork and nori, chopsticks lifting a tangle of noodles out of the steaming broth.

items.name: Rangoli Powder Bloom
items.note: A symmetric rangoli draws itself ring by ring in bright coloured powder, trickled from a pinching hand onto a red oxide floor.

items.name: Ransom Note Cutouts
items.note: Big letters cut from magazines in clashing colours and sizes, taped on a desk, each one flipping over now and then for a fresh clipping.

items.name: Reaction Diffusion
items.note: Gray-Scott reaction diffusion growing coral, spots and mazes outward from a handful of seeds.

items.name: Interactive Rebase Todo
items.note: An interactive rebase todo list where commits are squashed, reworded, dropped and reordered before the rebase replays them.

items.name: Record Player
items.note: A wooden turntable seen from above, the record spinning under the tonearm while music notes drift up.

items.name: Mainframe Tape Drives
items.note: Three mainframe tape drives side by side, their reels starting and stopping in read bursts, tape packs shifting from reel to reel and loops bobbing in the vacuum columns.

items.name: Relay Chat Channel
items.note: A terminal relay chat client where people join and leave a channel, chat with timestamps and the nick list updates beside them.

items.name: Retro Synth Sunset
items.note: A striped retro sun sinks behind neon wireframe mountains while a perspective grid scrolls toward you.

items.name: Ribosome Translation
items.note: A ribosome slides along mRNA three bases at a time as matching tRNAs drop in, link their amino acids into a growing protein and leave, until a stop codon releases the chain.

items.name: Rice Terraces
items.note: Bright green rice terraces step down the hillsides while soft clouds drift across the valley.

items.name: Saturn Ring Shadow
items.note: A close view of a ringed planet as the shadow of its globe slides across the rings, the rings throw thin bands of shade on its clouds and a small moon crosses.

items.name: Ringed Gas Giant
items.note: A banded gas giant turns inside its tilted rings while two small moons slip in front and behind.

items.name: Ripple Pond
items.note: Drops fall into a still pond between lily pads, and their circular ripples spread, cross and fade.

items.name: River Bridge Taxis
items.note: Yellow taxis stream across a giant steel cantilever bridge as the sun sets over the wide river and country boats drift below.

items.name: River Lantern Festival
items.note: Paper lanterns rise slowly into the night from a crowded arched bridge, glowing over the river and the lit town beyond.

items.name: Drone Sign Crew
items.note: A crew of tiny drones ferries blocks from a depot to build a big OPEN sign on a blueprint, then carries it all back.

items.name: Waving Tin Robot
items.note: A friendly tin robot waves hello with one arm, blinks its round screen eyes and flashes the light on its antenna.

items.name: Rock Blaster
items.note: A small arrow ship in deep space turns, thrusts and fires on its own, splitting tumbling space rocks into smaller and smaller pieces.

items.name: Rock Cycle Loop
items.note: A rock grain travels the rock cycle: magma cools into igneous rock, weathers into sediment, is pressed into sedimentary rock, squeezed into metamorphic rock and melts again.

items.name: Rocket Launch
items.note: A rocket ignites on the pad at dusk and climbs away on a column of flame, leaving a billowing cloud behind.

items.name: Rooftop Kite Sunset
items.note: On the winter kite festival, people on crowded city rooftops tug their strings as bright paper kites swoop across the sunset.

items.name: Rope Bridge Crossing
items.note: A hiker crosses a plank rope bridge over a canyon at dusk, the Verlet simulated deck sagging and bouncing under every step.

items.name: Twisted Rope
items.note: A thick twisted rope laid across the page, its strands rolling along as it slowly turns.

items.name: Rotary Phone
items.note: A red desk telephone whose finger wheel turns to the stop and springs back as a number is dialled.

items.name: Rotating Cube
items.note: A solid cube tumbling on two axes, each face lit flat with a character ramp and crisp bright edges.

items.name: Dodecahedron
items.note: A solid dodecahedron tumbling on three axes, its twelve pentagon faces lit in blue, amber and green with crisp edges.

items.name: Rotating Star
items.note: A thick five-pointed gold star extruded in 3D, spinning on its axis and catching the light on its bevels.

items.name: Rotozoomer
items.note: The demoscene rotozoomer, a checkered XOR texture spinning and zooming in and out.

items.name: Rover on Red Dunes
items.note: A six-wheeled rover rolls across rippled red dunes, wheels turning and mast camera scanning, leaving twin tracks and a trail of dust under a butterscotch sky.

items.name: Rule 30
items.note: The rule 30 elementary cellular automaton growing from a single cell, its chaotic triangles scrolling upward.

items.name: Sand Crab Scuttle
items.note: A red crab scuttles sideways across a sunny beach, claws raised, darting up the sand whenever a wave washes in.

items.name: Budget Sankey Flow
items.note: A monthly budget as a sankey diagram, three income streams pouring through curved ribbons into five spending categories, with money flowing along each band.

items.name: Satellite Orbit
items.note: A satellite with glinting solar panel wings circles a cloudy blue planet, slipping behind it and back into the light.

items.name: Savanna Sunset
items.note: Acacia trees stand black against a huge orange sun while giraffes and elephants walk across the plain.

items.name: Penguin in a Scarf
items.note: A round penguin in a striped red scarf stands in the falling snow, its scarf tail flapping in the wind as it hops and flaps to keep warm.

items.name: Scatter Plot
items.note: Points landing one by one in a scatter plot of ad spend against revenue, then a fitted trend line drawing through them.

items.name: Ribbon Banner
items.note: A crimson ribbon banner with folded, notched tails, gold trim and a sheen sliding across the cloth.

items.name: Sea Torii Sunset
items.note: A shrine gate stands in the sea as the sun sets between its posts, with waves rolling in and gulls crossing the sky.

items.name: Search Autocomplete
items.note: A search box where suggestions narrow and highlight with every keystroke, then a result is picked with the arrow keys.

items.name: Seasons From Axial Tilt
items.note: Earth circles the Sun with its axis always tilted 23.4 degrees the same way, so each hemisphere leans toward the Sun for summer and away for winter, shown in orbit and close up.

items.name: Seed Germination
items.note: A pea seed in the soil soaks up water, pushes its first root down, sends a hooked shoot up through the surface and opens its first leaves, with each stage and day labelled.

items.name: Sequence Diagram
items.note: A login sequence diagram where requests and dashed replies draw across the lifelines one after another.

items.name: Settings Toggles
items.note: A settings panel where a focus marker moves down the list, flipping switches and dragging sliders.

items.name: Vintage Sewing Machine
items.note: A black and gold vintage sewing machine whirs away, needle bobbing and handwheel turning as gingham fabric feeds through and a blue seam appears.

items.name: Sheet Music Playhead
items.note: A grand staff of sheet music scrolls past a fixed playhead, each note lighting up red as it sounds while the bars and bass line roll by.

items.name: Sierpinski Triangle
items.note: The chaos game at work: a point hops halfway to random corners and a Sierpinski triangle appears out of the noise.

items.name: Simple Circuit Current
items.note: A switch closes and electrons drift from the negative terminal round through a resistor and a bulb, which lights, while meters show 6 volts, 12 ohms and half an amp.

items.name: Singing Mouth Choir
items.note: A cute choir of round faced singers in two rows, each part opening its mouth in turn for four part harmony while little notes float up from the stage.

items.name: Sitar String Pluck
items.note: A finger stops a fret on a sitar, the main string is plucked and blurs into a decaying vibration while sound rings spread out from the gourd.

items.name: Sizzling Skewer Grill
items.note: Three kebab skewers of meat, peppers and onion turn over glowing charcoal while flames lick up, fat spits and smoke rolls away.

items.name: Skeleton Loader
items.note: Shimmering skeleton placeholders for a feed of cards that dissolve into the real content.

items.name: Sleeping Cat
items.note: A ginger tabby curled up asleep on a red cushion, breathing slowly as little z's drift up into the warm room.

items.name: Drowsy Crescent Moon
items.note: A crescent moon in a striped nightcap rocks gently in the night sky, snoring little z's as soft clouds drift past below.

items.name: Letter Slot Reels
items.note: A lever pulls, five reels of big letters blur past and thunk to a stop one by one to spell a word, and coins rattle into the tray.

items.name: Smart Home Panel
items.note: A home dashboard where lights flip on room by room, the thermostat climbs to its target, the door locks and the energy graph scrolls.

items.name: Rising Smoke Rings
items.note: A brick chimney puffs out smoke rings that rise, widen, wobble and slowly thin away into a dusky sky.

items.name: Snake
items.note: A self-playing snake that hunts the food on its own and starts over when it traps itself.

items.name: Slithering Snake
items.note: A banded green snake slithers across rippled desert sand in a smooth S curve, flicking its tongue and leaving a track.

items.name: Fox Trotting in Snow
items.note: A red fox trots through fresh powder past snowy pine woods, bushy tail swaying and paw prints trailing behind it as snow falls.

items.name: Snow Globe
items.note: A glass snow globe on a wooden base, holding a tiny lit cottage and a fir tree while snow swirls around them.

items.name: Snowfall Valley
items.note: Three layers of snow falling over a pine valley at night while the drifts slowly pile up.

items.name: Snowy Cabin
items.note: A log cabin glows in snowy woods at dusk while chimney smoke curls up and snow keeps falling.

items.name: Solar Flare Eruption
items.note: The boiling edge of the sun fills the frame while plasma runs along a glowing magnetic loop and a flare erupts, flinging bright matter into space.

items.name: Bubble vs Quick Sort
items.note: Bubble sort and quicksort race on the same shuffled bars, highlighting each comparison, swap and pivot, so quicksort finishes and waits while bubble sort is still carrying large values to the end.

items.name: Soup Ladle Service
items.note: A steel ladle dips into a steaming red pot of tomato soup and swings over to fill a row of white bowls one after another.

items.name: Sparkline Panel
items.note: Six labelled sparklines scrolling with their live values, trend arrows and a range bar.

items.name: Grinder Sparks
items.note: An angle grinder bites into a steel bar on a workbench, throwing a bright fan of sparks that arc down and bounce across the floor.

items.name: Spectrum Music Player
items.note: A music player window with bouncing spectrum bars, a moving progress bar and a playlist that advances track by track.

items.name: Speed Gauge
items.note: A semicircular speed test gauge with green to red bands and a needle swinging to the live reading.

items.name: Sphere to Cube Morph
items.note: A turning solid that swells from a smooth ball into a sharp cube and back, each of its six sides painted its own colour.

items.name: Spider Web
items.note: A spider spins an orb web at dusk, spoke by spoke and then round and round, until dew glints along the finished threads.

items.name: Spinner Set
items.note: Twelve classic terminal spinners side by side, each labelled with its name and frame count.

items.name: Spinning Gold Coin
items.note: A thick gold coin with a raised star and a ridged rim spinning on its edge, its shadow stretching and shrinking on the floor below.

items.name: Spinning Torus
items.note: A lit ring turning slowly on two axes, shaded with a classic character ramp.

items.name: Spiral Galaxy
items.note: A tilted spiral galaxy turns slowly, its golden core feeding two blue arms dotted with pink star nurseries.

items.name: Spirograph
items.note: A toothed wheel rolls inside a ring, its pen tracing hypotrochoid curves layered in colour, then a fresh set begins.

items.name: Split Flap Board
items.note: An airport departures board where every tile flaps through the alphabet to show the next flights.

items.name: Split Pane Multiplexer
items.note: A terminal multiplexer split into a streaming server log, a live resource meter and a test watcher, with focus hopping between panes.

items.name: Spreadsheet Recalc
items.note: A budget spreadsheet where a cell is edited, its formula bar updates and the dependent totals flash as they recalculate.

items.name: Spring Coil
items.note: A steel coil spring hanging from a beam, stretching and recoiling under a turning weight, lit with a bright metallic glint.

items.name: Spring Mass
items.note: Masses bob on coil springs at their own natural frequencies, and a coupled pair passes its energy back and forth between two normal modes.

items.name: Sprouting Pot Plant
items.note: A little pot plant on a sunny window sill catches a drop of water, slowly unfurls a brand new leaf and gives a big happy smile.

items.name: SQL Query Runner
items.note: A database console types a SQL query with highlighting, runs it and fills a result grid with rows and timing.

items.name: Secure Shell Login
items.note: A remote shell session that accepts a host key, prints a welcome banner with system stats, runs two commands and logs out.

items.name: Stacked Area Stream
items.note: A stacked area chart of requests per second from four regions, new samples streaming in on the right while the history slides away to the left.

items.name: Star Rating Review
items.note: A review card where the cursor hovers across five stars, settles on a rating, writes a short review and posts it to the tally.

items.name: Starburst
items.note: Rainbow rays bursting from a white hot centre while rings pulse outward through them.

items.name: Starfield Warp
items.note: Hundreds of stars streak outward from the centre as the view punches through space at warp speed.

items.name: Twinkle Star Band
items.note: A narrow band of twinkling dots and four-pointed sparkles that bloom and fade in white, gold and lilac.

items.name: State Machine
items.note: A data fetching state machine where the active state lights up and a token runs each labelled transition, through errors and retries.

items.name: States Of Matter Particles
items.note: Three boxes of particles: a solid vibrating in a fixed lattice, a liquid sliding in a close jumble and a gas flying fast and far apart, with melting, boiling and their reverses marked.

items.name: Stencil Spray Paint
items.note: A spray can zigzags over a card stencil taped to a brick wall, the stencil peels away to reveal the painted word, and a roller paints it over.

items.name: Stilt Village Sunset
items.note: Thatched huts stand on stilts over calm water as the sun sets, while two fishing boats row home, smoke rises and birds fly over.

items.name: Stock Ticker
items.note: A market ticker tape of made-up symbols scrolling past with green and red arrows, prices and percent changes.

items.name: Stomping Little Dino
items.note: A chubby little green dinosaur stomps in place under a smoking volcano, kicking up dust, flailing its tiny arms and letting out a big roar.

items.name: Studio Mixing Desk
items.note: A studio mixing console with twelve channel strips, faders gliding on automation, LED meters bouncing and two needle VU meters on the master bus.

items.name: Subduction Zone Volcano
items.note: A cross-section where an oceanic plate dives under a continent at a trench, melts in the hot mantle and feeds magma up into an erupting volcano, every layer labelled.

items.name: Subtitle Captions
items.note: A night rooftop scene plays in a video frame while timed captions appear with coloured speaker names, sound cues and a moving scrubber.

items.name: Sugarloaf Cable Car
items.note: Rio's bay at golden hour, with cable cars climbing to the top of the domed granite peak, sailboats crossing, frigatebirds gliding and palms swaying on the beach.

items.name: Hot Afternoon Cooler
items.note: A hot afternoon indoors: the ceiling fan whirls, the desert cooler blows the curtains about and the wall calendar flips from one scorching day to the next.

items.name: Summit Above Clouds
items.note: A snowy peak glows pink above a drifting sea of cloud at sunrise while a roped line of climbers walks the ridge below.

items.name: Sunrise Horizon
items.note: The sun climbs over a flat sea horizon while the sky shifts from deep night through dawn pinks to clear day.

items.name: Supertree Grove Night
items.note: Tall steel supertrees glow magenta, violet and teal at night beside a city skyline, while people stroll the garden path and cross the high skywalk.

items.name: Sushi Conveyor Belt
items.note: Colour rimmed plates of salmon, tuna, egg and prawn nigiri and cucumber maki glide past on a steel belt below a swaying indigo curtain.

items.name: Swimming Whale
items.note: A humpback whale glides beneath the waves through shafts of light, rising now and then to blow a spout.

items.name: Switchback Dusk Drive
items.note: Cars wind down a switchback mountain road at dusk, headlights sweeping the bends under an orange afterglow while the first stars come out.

items.name: Syntax Highlight Pass
items.note: Code is typed into an editor as plain grey text, then the language is detected and syntax colour sweeps down the file line by line.

items.name: Synthwave Grid
items.note: A neon grid rushing toward a striped sunset sun, with purple hills on the horizon.

items.name: Tab Bar
items.note: An editor tab bar where the active underline slides between files and the content swaps beneath.

items.name: Tabla Teental Hands
items.note: Two hands play a sixteen beat teental theka on a tabla pair, each stroke rippling the drum heads while the bols light up in a strip above.

items.name: Taj Mahal Sunset
items.note: A white domed mausoleum with four minarets glows at sunset above its long reflecting pool.

items.name: Tap Tempo Counter
items.note: A tap tempo tool where each tap flashes the pad with a ripple while the BPM readout settles, the intervals chart fills and the beat lights lock in.

items.name: TCP Handshake Ladder
items.note: A packet ladder diagram where SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK step down between client and server, followed by a request, its reply and the four-way close, with each socket state logged as it changes.

items.name: Tea Poured From Height
items.note: A silver teapot is lifted high as it pours a long amber stream of mint tea into a small gold-rimmed glass, foam rising and steam curling.

items.name: Teleprompter Script
items.note: A speech script scrolls up a prompter screen past a marked reading line, with stage cues, a recording light and a running timer.

items.name: Teletype Paper Roll
items.note: A teletype prints a time-sharing session onto a roll of paper, the type head running along each line, keys going down as the user types and the paper feeding upward.

items.name: Temple Sunset
items.note: A cliff-top temple in bougainvillea above a calm sea at sunset.

items.name: Terminal Session
items.note: A shell session where commands are typed at a coloured prompt and their output streams back.

items.name: Terrain Mesh Flyover
items.note: A low flight over an endless gridded landscape, green valleys rising to rocky ridges and snowy peaks that sweep toward the camera under a dusk sky.

items.name: Tesseract
items.note: A four dimensional hypercube turning through the fourth axis, its inner and outer cubes swapping places as it projects down.

items.name: Test Suite Dots
items.note: A test runner that prints a dot per passing test across files, flags a failure with a diff and ends in a coloured summary.

items.name: Tethered Spacewalk
items.note: An astronaut drifts on a curling tether beside a station hull, waving now and then, while the cloudy blue earth turns slowly far below.

items.name: Lighthouse Text Adventure
items.note: A text adventure in an old lighthouse where the player types commands at the prompt, the parser answers, the score and move counter tick up and the light is lit at last.

items.name: Text Scramble
items.note: Random block letters churn and settle one slot at a time into a phrase, then scramble away into the next.

items.name: Thames Clock Tower
items.note: London's floodlit clock tower and gothic riverside front glow at dusk, as a red double-decker bus crosses the bridge and boats pass on the river below.

items.name: Timeline
items.note: A horizontal company timeline where a moving marker reveals each milestone, labels popping up above and below the line.

items.name: Toast Stack
items.note: Notification toasts slide into the corner of an app, stack up, count down and slide away.

items.name: Toaster Pops Toast
items.note: A chrome toaster squints and glows as it concentrates, then pops two golden slices high into the air and catches them with a grin.

items.name: Token Bucket Limiter
items.note: A token bucket rate limiter where tokens drip in at a fixed rate, each request spends one on its way to the API, and a sudden burst drains the bucket so the overflow is turned away with 429s.

items.name: Tokyo Crossing
items.note: Crowds stream across a scramble crossing at night beneath walls of glowing, flickering billboards.

items.name: Tornado
items.note: A twisting tornado funnel snakes across open plains under a green storm sky, flinging dust and debris around its base.

items.name: Torus Knot
items.note: A glossy tube tied in a trefoil torus knot, turning slowly, lit and depth-sorted so it passes over and under itself.

items.name: Tower Defence Wave
items.note: Waves of creeps march along a winding dirt road while cannon, frost and laser towers built beside it hold the line.

items.name: Trace Span Waterfall
items.note: A distributed tracing waterfall where nested spans for each service grow along a millisecond axis as a checkout request runs, followed by a slower trace whose payment call times out and retries.

items.name: Traffic Light
items.note: A street crossing where the signal cycles green, amber and red while cars stop, queue and pull away.

items.name: Train at Dusk
items.note: A passenger train with glowing windows crosses a stone viaduct over a misty valley at dusk.

items.name: Transverse And Longitudinal
items.note: A wave on a string, where each bead moves up and down, above a sound wave in air, where each particle moves back and forth, with wavelength, compressions and rarefactions marked.

items.name: Disk Usage Treemap
items.note: A treemap of disk usage by folder, the boxes growing, shrinking and trading places as caches fill and logs rotate.

items.name: Candy Trefoil Tube
items.note: A fat red and cream striped tube tied in a trefoil knot, the stripes flowing around the loop while the knot slowly turns.

items.name: Tropical Island
items.note: Swaying palms on a small island ringed by turquoise water, waves lapping under a high sun.

items.name: Truchet Tiles
items.note: A grid of quarter-circle Truchet tiles turning in rippling waves, the tubes re-routing into new flowing paths.

items.name: Texture Tunnel
items.note: A flight down an endless checkered tunnel that bends and twists as it goes.

items.name: TV Static
items.note: An untuned television full of snowy static, a brighter bar rolling slowly down the screen.

items.name: Twin Pane Commander
items.note: A retro two-pane file manager where the cursor picks files, a copy dialog fills its progress bar and the files land in the other pane.

items.name: Typebar Close-Up
items.note: A close-up inside a typewriter: one typebar after another swings up from the fanned basket to strike the ribbon, and letters appear on the paper as the carriage steps along.

items.name: Typewriter
items.note: Big block letters typed one key at a time behind a block cursor, wrapping onto new lines before the page clears.

items.name: Underwater Reef
items.note: A coral reef where fish swim through shafts of light falling from the surface as bubbles rise.

items.name: Unfolding Poem
items.note: An original poem is written out line by line behind a pen cursor, each letter settling from faint to full ink, then lifts away for the next poem.

items.name: Upload Dropzone
items.note: A cursor drags a stack of files onto a drop zone that lights up, then each file uploads with its own progress bar.

items.name: Status Page
items.note: A service status page with daily uptime bars sliding along and the occasional incident turning a service amber or red.

items.name: Valentine Hearts
items.note: Shaded red and pink hearts of every size float upwards and sway through a warm rose haze.

items.name: Vaporwave Sun
items.note: A striped retro sun sinks into a scrolling neon grid sea while cloud streaks drift past and a CRT roll bar slides down the screen.

items.name: Vector Space Duel
items.note: Two wireframe ships circle a flickering star on a green vector display, firing torpedoes, leaving phosphor trails, until one breaks apart and respawns.

items.name: Venn Diagram
items.note: Three overlapping circles, corrected to stay round, with each region and overlap lighting up in turn and naming what lives there.

items.name: Vertical Haiku Scroll
items.note: Original haiku are brushed onto a hanging scroll in vertical columns read right to left, finished with a red seal, while a leaf drifts past.

items.name: Viaduct Steam Train
items.note: An old steam train crosses a tall arched stone viaduct between the mountains, puffing steam as mist drifts through the valley.

items.name: Victoria Harbour Junk
items.note: Hong Kong's towers glow below the dark peak at night as a junk with red battened sails crosses the harbour and two ferries ply between the shores.

items.name: Vinyl Crate Digging
items.note: A hand digs through a wooden crate of records, tipping each sleeve forward to reveal the next bold cover with its price sticker.

items.name: Volcano Eruption
items.note: A volcano erupts into the night, throwing up lava bombs while glowing rivers run down its sides.

items.name: Voronoi Cells
items.note: Fourteen drifting seed points and the Voronoi regions they claim, shaded like moving stained glass.

items.name: Voxel Heart
items.note: A chunky heart built from small red cubes, turning slowly and giving a double beat every couple of seconds.

items.name: Waffle Iron Opening
items.note: A round waffle iron puffs steam, its lid swings open on a golden grid waffle, the waffle is lifted out and the lid closes on the next batch.

items.name: Happy Wagging Pup
items.note: A floppy eared puppy sits in a sunny park, wagging its tail, panting with its tongue out and tilting its head as if asked a question.

items.name: Walking Dog
items.note: A golden dog trots happily along a park path, tail wagging and ears bouncing while the trees and clouds roll by.

items.name: Washing Machine
items.note: A front loading washer tumbling a colourful load through soapy water, then draining and spinning fast.

items.name: Pool Caustics
items.note: Shimmering networks of light dancing across the tiled floor of a swimming pool.

items.name: Water Cycle Diagram
items.note: Water evaporates from the sea, condenses into a cloud, rains on the mountains and runs back to the sea above and below ground, with every stage labelled.

items.name: Waterfall
items.note: A tall waterfall pours between dark mossy cliffs into a churning pool, throwing up spray and drifting mist.

items.name: Waterfall Canyon
items.note: A tall waterfall drops between striped canyon walls into a green pool, throwing up spray and mist.

items.name: Wave Divider
items.note: Two soft sine waves roll across a thin band, their colour drifting from blue to pink to orange.

items.name: Wave Function Collapse
items.note: A terrain map is solved by wave function collapse, the lowest entropy tile collapsing first and every choice narrowing what its neighbours can become.

items.name: Wave Interference
items.note: Two vibrating sources send out circular waves that reinforce and cancel, carving the classic fan of nodal lines as the sources drift apart.

items.name: Wave Text
items.note: Big block letters bob along a travelling sine wave, brightening at each crest, with shadows that shrink as they rise.

items.name: Weather City Widget
items.note: A weather widget that slides from city to city, each with an animated sky icon, hourly temperatures and a five day outlook.

items.name: Wind Through Grass
items.note: A field of tall grass bends and shimmers silver as gusts of wind roll across it under a summer sky.

items.name: Windmill on a Hill
items.note: An old windmill on a green hill, its lattice sails turning above a striped tulip field at sunset.

items.name: Window Tiling Manager
items.note: A desktop where windows open one by one and the tiling layout slides between halves, columns and a grid.

items.name: Wireframe City Flyby
items.note: A night flight down a long avenue between wireframe towers, cyan and magenta edges racing past over a gridded street.

items.name: Wireframe Globe
items.note: A wire sphere of latitude and longitude lines turning on a tilted axis, near lines bright and far lines dim behind.

items.name: Line Drawn Maze Crawl
items.note: An early first-person maze game drawn in amber lines, gliding down corridors and turning at junctions by the right-hand rule while a map tracks each step.

items.name: Word Exchange
items.note: Everyday words trade like shares on a quote screen, with a crawling tape, a table of prices that tick up and down and a chart for the word of the hour.

items.name: Word Ladder Morph
items.note: A word ladder where one big letter at a time dissolves and re-forms into its neighbour, turning COLD into WARM while the steps are listed beside it.

items.name: World Map Pings
items.note: A dotted world map where live request pings flare up in cities and arcs carry traffic between them.

items.name: Yawning Coffee Mug
items.note: A sleepy coffee mug on its saucer gives a long stretchy yawn as curls of steam rise, then blinks itself wide awake.

items.name: Zigzag Rule
items.note: A doubled zigzag rule that scrolls sideways while a rainbow gradient slides along it.
